US F-35 Fighter Jet Parts Diverted to Hong Kong, Investigation Underway

Parts for the US F-35 stealth fighter jet were diverted from a shipment bound for the United States to Hong Kong, prompting an investigation. Australia confirmed that parts, including a canopy, went missing after a shipment was unexpectedly rerouted. The incident is under probe in the US Congress. The F-35 is a US stealth fighter jet.
